metadata.title: Gritty Urban Portraiture with High-Contrast Textures

retrievalProfile.description: A tight, high-contrast urban portrait featuring a central subject with a hand partially obscuring the face, emphasizing skin texture, tattoos, and cultural accessories like bandanas and dreadlocks.
excludeWhen: requesting bright, airy, or minimalist lifestyle photography

recipe.visualDefinition: A square-format, extreme close-up portrait of a man with dark skin, dreadlocks, and a black paisley bandana. His hand is positioned vertically over the center of his face, fingers spread to reveal one eye. The lighting is harsh and directional, creating deep shadows and highlighting every pore, wrinkle, and tattoo detail against a dark, desaturated background.
coreVisualRelationships: Hand as a central vertical divider of the facial features
High-contrast interplay between deep shadows and specular highlights on skin
Repetitive patterns of dreadlocks framing the face against the complex bandana print
Intense eye contact through the gaps of the fingers

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face and hand occupy 80% of the frame, centered vertically and horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The palm and fingers of the hand, which create a strong vertical line through the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the visible eye, moves down the length of the fingers, and follows the dreadlocks to the edges of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, restricted to the dark corners and the area behind the dreadlocks.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark grays in the background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm, earthy brown tones of the skin and hair.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White highlights on the bandana pattern and fingernails.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with a heavy emphasis on value contrast (chiaroscuro effect).

treatment.outline: thin white border around black box

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family in a boxed badge format.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary condensed, heavy weight for a warning label aesthetic.
Classic grotesque feel that matches urban editorial styles.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, moody close-up portrait of a man with dreadlocks and a bandana, with his hand covering his face, emphasizing skin texture and shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a small, rectangular black-and-white 'Parental Advisory' style badge in the bottom right corner using a bold condensed sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the hand the central focal point?
Is the skin texture highly detailed and sharp?
Is the lighting dramatic with deep shadows?
Is the advisory badge in the bottom right corner?

adjustableVariables: Degree of hand coverage over the face
mustRedesign: Specific facial tattoos to avoid direct likeness
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the eye visible through the fingers has a sharp catchlight.
Check that the bandana texture is distinct from the hair texture.
Verify the background is sufficiently dark to make the subject pop.
Confirm the typography is contained within a clean rectangular border.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Extreme Close-up Portrait] + [Hand-over-face Pose] + [High-Contrast Chiaroscuro Lighting] + [Urban Cultural Signifiers: Bandana/Dreadlocks] + [Corner-aligned Warning Badge].
